name: the cards resolve into a connected constellation
looks: The wall of cards gives way to a looser constellation: small scattered marks, a few picked out in red, connected by thin lines like a network, before the frame settles back on one clean, glowing copy of the mark alone in the dark.
build: DOM/SVG nodes at scattered seeded positions, connecting lines drawn on with strokeDashoffset between nearby nodes, a subset recoloured to the accent for emphasis; the shot ends by cross-fading the whole field down to a single centred instance of the mark with its soft glow.
sound: A soft tick per connecting line, a low hum under the field, a settling chime as it resolves to the single mark.
prompt: Pull back from a dense wall of options into a looser constellation of connected points, with a few picked out in an accent colour, then let the whole field settle back down to one clean, glowing mark alone -- read it as 'many things, one system, one symbol.'
